ConnectionStrings.//: Required. No default — PostgreSQL is the one external dependency and there is no sensible fallback. Override with ConnectionStrings__Default.

Hosting.//PublicUrl: Optional. The address operators use to reach this installation, e.g. https://cms.example.com. Used only by the 'identity recovery-link' command to print a complete link.
Hosting.//: Empty KnownProxies/KnownNetworks means no forwarded header is trusted. Name your proxy before putting one in front.
Hosting.//AdminHostNames: Optional. Host names on which /api and /admin answer. Empty means every host name. When set, other host names serve only the public surface; /health answers everywhere.

Identity.//AllowInsecureHttp: Leave false. True accepts credentials over plain HTTP from other machines and logs a warning at every startup.

Storage.//: Where uploaded files live (specs/003-media-storage research M-05). Local is the only provider in this release.

Local.//Path: Absolute, and outside the application's own directories. Empty means the per-user default ({LocalApplicationData}/QuickBuilder/media); the container image sets /var/lib/quickbuilder/media.

Media.//AllowedTypes: Unset means all six: image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, image/webp, image/avif, application/pdf. Set Media__AllowedTypes__0, __1, ... to narrow the list; entries outside those six stop startup.

Cache.//MemoryLimitMegabytes: Upper bound on the in-memory cache per instance, 16 to 16384. Rendered pages dominate it (specs/012-publishing-rendering research PR-07).

Telemetry.//: Empty OtlpEndpoint means no exporter is registered and nothing leaves the process.
